Excerpts of registered dev-DB atlas tables (2026-10-17) used by tests/unit/test_v6_politics.py for the derived change
tables of src/reva/adapters/connectors/atlas_politics_derived.py. Rows are unchanged (atlas long schema, raw sha256
and selectors of the provider bytes they were parsed from).

* bis_cbpol_d_xm_excerpt.csv -- atlas.bis.cbpol_d (artifact 69b5c9cd...), euro area (XM), 2022-07-20..2022-11-09.
  Licence: BIS terms of permitted use of BIS statistics (cite the BIS as the source).
* oecd_cts_cit_usa_excerpt.csv -- atlas.oecd.cts_cit (artifact 42f6e058...), United States, standard rates
  (targeting=ST), 2015-2020. Licence: OECD open by default (CC BY 4.0).
